title: Apple Security Research Device
summary:
The Apple Security Research Device (SRD) Program is designed to accelerate iOS security research for both new and experienced researchers. It provides a specially fused iPhone, the Security Research Device (SRD), which enables deep-level security research without the need to bypass its native security features.

Researchers using the SRD gain shell access, the ability to run custom tools, choose entitlements, and even customize the kernel. The program also offers access to software previews, security beta projects, a dedicated research community, and specialized tooling. Research can cover all iOS and iPhone components, excluding Apple Pay and third-party apps.

Vulnerabilities discovered with the SRD are automatically considered for the Apple Security Bounty, including bonus awards for preview and beta software. Participants are expected to promptly report all findings to Apple, and to relevant third parties if applicable.

The SRD is provided as a 12-month renewable loan, remaining Apple's property, and is strictly for controlled security research. It's not for personal use, must remain on program participants' premises, and access is limited to Apple-authorized individuals.

Eligibility requires a proven track record in finding security issues on Apple or other modern platforms, legal age of majority, and not having been an Apple employee within the last 12 months, along with residency in an eligible country. Applications are open until October 30, 2026, with a limited number of devices available each year.
chinese_title: 苹果安全研究设备
chinese_summary:
苹果安全研究设备 (SRD) 项目旨在加速新手和经验丰富的研究人员对 iOS 的安全研究。该项目提供一款特殊熔断的 iPhone，即安全研究设备 (SRD)，可进行深度安全研究，且无需绕过其原生安全功能。

使用 SRD 的研究人员可获得 shell 访问权限，能够运行自定义工具、选择授权，甚至自定义内核。该项目还提供软件预览版、安全测试版项目、专属研究社区以及专用工具的访问权限。研究可涵盖所有 iOS 和 iPhone 组件，但不包括 Apple Pay 和第三方应用。

通过 SRD 发现的漏洞将自动纳入苹果安全赏金计划的考量范围，包括针对预览版和测试版软件的额外奖励。参与者需及时向苹果报告所有发现，并在适用情况下向相关的第三方报告。

SRD 以 12 个月可续借的借用形式提供，仍归苹果所有，且严格用于受控的安全研究。该设备不得用于个人用途，必须保留在项目参与者的场所内，访问权限仅限于苹果授权人员。

申请资格要求包括在苹果或其他现代平台上发现安全问题的良好记录、达到法定成年年龄、在过去 12 个月内未曾是苹果员工，以及居住在符合条件的国家/地区。申请截止日期为 2026 年 10 月 30 日，每年可用的设备数量有限。

title: Five Qwen3.8-27B models match Fable 5 Using GVS5H Harness
summary:
The GVS5H method, or "Gorilla vs. 5 Humans," introduces ledger-based zero-shot self-orchestration, a training-free approach that enables fresh instances of a single model to decompose complex coding problems and coordinate via a shared filesystem. This method allows open-weight models like Qwen3.8-27B to achieve performance comparable to or exceeding frontier models like Fable 5 on coding benchmarks.

On 100 hard LiveCodeBench problems, GVS5H yields significant performance gains, up to 25.6 percentage points. Notably, orchestrated Qwen3.8 Flash Next achieved 93.0% pass@1, surpassing Fable 5's 90.4% at only 9% of the cost. Furthermore, a locally served, open-weight Qwen3.8-27B dramatically improved its pass@1 score from 66.8% to 92.4%, effectively matching Fable 5's capabilities.

The paper attributes these gains to problem decomposition and persistent context, demonstrating that inference-time organization can approach or even slightly exceed frontier coding accuracy with self-hostable weights at a fraction of the cost. While powerful, the method does not universally improve all models. The code is open-source under the MIT License.
chinese_title: 五个 Qwen3.8-27B 模型使用 GVS5H Harness 媲美 Fable 5
chinese_summary:
GVS5H方法，也称为“大猩猩 vs. 5 个人类”，引入了基于账本的零样本自编排技术。这是一种无需训练的方法，能够让单个模型的新实例分解复杂的编码问题，并通过共享文件系统进行协作。该方法使得Qwen3.8-27B等开源模型在编码基准测试中，能够达到或超越Fable 5等前沿模型的性能。

在100个困难的LiveCodeBench问题上，GVS5H带来了显著的性能提升，最高达25.6个百分点。值得注意的是，经过编排的Qwen3.8 Flash Next实现了93.0%的pass@1，超越了Fable 5的90.4%，而成本仅为后者的9%。此外，一个在本地部署的开源Qwen3.8-27B模型将其pass@1分数从66.8%大幅提升至92.4%，有效地与Fable 5的能力持平。

该论文将这些提升归因于问题分解和持久上下文，表明推理时期的组织通过可自托管的权重，能够以一小部分成本接近甚至略微超越前沿编码准确性。尽管功能强大，但该方法并非能普遍改进所有模型。其代码已根据MIT许可开源。

title: Dream-1
summary:
Dream Labs has launched with $90M in seed funding, introducing Dream-1, a bimanual robot with parallel grippers, available globally via a public API. Dream-1 aims to solve robotics' long-standing "chicken-and-egg" problem: robots need to be useful to gather data, but require data to become useful.

This breakthrough is enabled by two factors: rapidly decreasing robot hardware costs (e.g., $2k for a bimanual arm) and generalizable models that don't need extensive embodiment-specific data. Dream-1 is a World Action Model (WAM) built on the DreamZero paper, which showed 30 minutes of data could transfer general task knowledge.

Dream-1 offers zero-shot generalization, allowing it to control unseen robots for unseen tasks in unseen environments directly out of the box, without fine-tuning or machine learning expertise. It works by predicting end-effector (EEF) poses, which any bimanual parallel-gripper robot can translate into joint commands via its Inverse Kinematics solver. WAMs achieve this by learning to predict video and actions, treating all robots as pixel data.

The service is designed to be plug-and-play, costing $3/hour for Dream-1 or $2/hour for Dream-1-flash. An independent report by Robocurve highlights Dream-1's "better, faster, and cheaper" performance compared to existing models. Users can also fine-tune Dream-1 for specific tasks using FaaS if initial performance falls short.
chinese_summary:
Dream Labs已成功推出，并获得9000万美元种子轮融资，同时推出了Dream-1——一款配备平行夹爪的双臂机器人，可通过公共API在全球范围内使用。Dream-1旨在解决机器人领域长期存在的“鸡生蛋，蛋生鸡”难题：机器人需有用才能收集数据，但又需数据才能变得有用。

这一突破得益于两个因素：机器人硬件成本的迅速下降（例如，一套双臂机器人仅需2000美元）以及无需大量特定本体数据即可泛化的模型。Dream-1是一种基于DreamZero论文构建的“世界动作模型”（WAM），该论文表明30分钟的数据即可传递通用任务知识。

Dream-1提供零样本泛化能力，使其无需微调或机器学习专业知识，即可开箱即用，直接控制未知环境中的未知机器人执行未知任务。它通过预测末端执行器（EEF）姿态来工作，任何配备双臂平行夹爪的机器人都可以通过其逆运动学求解器将其转换为关节指令。WAM通过学习预测视频和动作来实现这一点，将所有机器人视为像素数据。

该服务设计为即插即用，Dream-1每小时收费3美元，Dream-1-flash每小时收费2美元。Robocurve的一份独立报告强调，与现有模型相比，Dream-1的性能“更好、更快、更便宜”。如果初始性能不尽如人意，用户还可以使用FaaS对Dream-1进行特定任务的微调。

title: Meta employees say Lula’s accounts restricted in Brazil election: Report
summary:
A report from Brazilian daily Folha de S Paulo, citing internal communications, indicates that Meta employees acknowledged restrictions negatively affecting Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's Instagram accounts during the country's election, while challenger Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's profile and WhatsApp channel were reportedly recommended.

Meta responded, stating these were public technical issues and internal discussions concerned their severity, not political interference, explicitly denying any bias.

This news followed Lula's complaint accusing Meta of using biased algorithms and AI restrictions to favor Bolsonaro ahead of the October 25 presidential runoff. Lula's party noted his posts sometimes lacked share buttons, had reduced reach, and missed other interactive options.

Consequently, Justice Marco Aurelio Bellizze of Brazil's top electoral court ordered Meta to immediately ensure equal treatment for both candidates. The ruling prohibits Meta from reducing political content distribution, restricting searches, or removing posts in a way that creates an imbalance, and mandates identical AI criteria for both campaigns. Non-compliance will incur a daily fine of 500,000 reais ($98,700).
chinese_title: Meta员工称卢拉巴西大选账号受限：报道
chinese_summary:
巴西《圣保罗页报》援引内部通讯报道称，Meta员工承认，在该国大选期间，限制措施对巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦的Instagram账户产生了负面影响，而据报道，挑战者参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗的个人资料和WhatsApp频道则获得了推荐。

Meta回应称，这些是公开的技术问题，内部讨论关注的是其严重性，而非政治干预，并明确否认存在任何偏见。

此前，卢拉曾抱怨Meta在10月25日总统决选前使用有偏见的算法和AI限制来偏袒博索纳罗。卢拉的政党指出，他的帖子有时缺少分享按钮，触达率降低，并且缺少其他互动选项。

因此，巴西最高选举法院法官马可·奥雷利奥·贝利泽命令Meta立即确保对两位候选人一视同仁。该裁决禁止Meta以造成不平衡的方式减少政治内容分发、限制搜索或删除帖子，并要求对两个竞选活动采用相同的AI标准。若不遵守，将面临每日50万雷亚尔（约合98,700美元）的罚款。

title: The Goose Programming Language
summary:
The Goose Programming Language is a memory-safe systems language designed for exceptional performance and low memory consumption, reportedly outperforming C++ and Rust in benchmarks. Its innovative memory model relies entirely on compiler-managed data stacks, eliminating heap allocators, garbage collectors, reference counting, and explicit lifetime annotations. Memory is automatically freed when its scope ends, and dynamic growth operations never move data, ensuring references remain valid.

Goose achieves memory safety by statically inferring reference roots, preventing dangling references without requiring `unsafe` blocks or lifetime syntax. Complex data structures, including variable-sized arrays, strings, and records with dynamic fields, are stored contiguously inline without pointers, leading to zero allocations for many types and efficient cache usage. Variable-mode Enums further optimize memory by storing variants at their actual size.

Other key features include narrow, position-independent relative references for efficient serialization, and guaranteed in-place value construction that avoids copies. A unique error handling mechanism, `return E from f`, allows static, checked returns up the call stack without `Result` types. Threads communicate via typed queues with `memcpy`, operating without shared memory, locks, or atomics. Generics and higher-order functions are compile-time entities, monomorphized with zero runtime overhead. Goose compiles to C, offering broad compatibility. Its syntax is familiar to C and Rust programmers.
chinese_title: 鹅编程语言
chinese_summary:
Goose 编程语言是一种内存安全的系统级语言，旨在实现卓越性能和低内存消耗，据报道在基准测试中超越了 C++ 和 Rust。其创新的内存模型完全依赖于编译器管理的数据栈，从而消除了堆分配器、垃圾回收器、引用计数和显式生命周期注解。内存在其作用域结束时自动释放，动态增长操作从不移动数据，从而确保引用始终有效。

Goose 通过静态推断引用根来实现内存安全，无需 `unsafe` 块或生命周期语法即可防止悬空引用。复杂数据结构，包括可变大小数组、字符串和带动态字段的记录，均以连续内联方式存储，无需指针，这使得许多类型实现零分配并有效利用缓存。可变模式枚举 (Enums) 通过以其实际大小存储变体，进一步优化内存。

其他主要特性包括用于高效序列化的窄的、与位置无关的相对引用，以及保证的就地值构造以避免复制。一种独特的错误处理机制，即 `return E from f`，允许沿调用栈进行静态的、检查过的返回，而无需 `Result` 类型。线程通过带 `memcpy` 的类型化队列进行通信，无需共享内存、锁或原子操作即可运行。泛型和高阶函数是编译时实体，经单态化处理后运行时开销为零。Goose 编译为 C 语言，提供广泛的兼容性。其语法对于 C 和 Rust 程序员来说很熟悉。
